summary: Re-ran every finding from both code-review reports on the lane's current head (feb99839). Four of five open findings are genuinely fixed and independently reproduced in this session: STANDARDS S1 (playwright.config.ts now pins testMatch: /.*\.spec\.ts$/ -- filterless `pnpm exec playwright test --list` prints zero TAP lines, Total: 556 tests in 48 files, confirmed live), STANDARDS S2 (the indirected-password bypass I hand-built -- `const password = page.getByLabel("Password"); await password.fill(...); const submit = ...; await submit.click();` -- now returns reimplementsLoginForm() === true when imported and probed directly), SPEC S1 (entry-faces-walk.spec.ts's FORM_EXCEPTIONS entry and README row are deleted; the census's own proximity window rejects a hand-built far-apart case and FORM_EXCEPTIONS now holds only reports-download-walk.spec.ts), and SPEC S3 (the floor comment and assertion now read 48/>=46, matching `ls -1 apps/web/e2e/*.spec.ts | wc -l` = 48; the '35 of 42' figure in the lane's final report is corrected to '35 of 46 (48 total)'). SPEC S4 (note) and STANDARDS S3 (note) are both resolved as the fix report claims: S4's 60s counterparty-identity figure is in wave1-lane02-final.md's 'measurement deliberately given up' paragraph and follow-up 2; S3's one-element-array choice carries its own justifying comment in documents-viewer-walk.spec.ts, unchanged. All three touched/added test files pass (e2e/run-args.test.ts 5/5, e2e/sign-in-census.test.ts 4/4, e2e/spec-discovery.test.ts 2/2), `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm lint` both exit 0, apps/web/test/manifest.txt is alphabetical with both new lines present (check-test-manifest.mjs: 482 files), and `git status` is clean at HEAD. One finding (SPEC S2, #858 AC3) is still open: the fix report's own dedicated 'SPEC S2' section and its Gates-table 'browser suite' row are literal unfilled template placeholders (BROWSER_EVIDENCE_PLACEHOLDER / BROWSER_GATE_PLACEHOLDER) despite the report's own intro claiming this finding was 'answered with evidence rather than code'. Neither of the required_fix's two remedies -- three consecutive whole-suite runs on an idle host, or a recorded owner ruling -- was delivered or drafted anywhere I could find (checked wave1-lane02-final.md, PROGRESS.md and the other lane02 report files); the final report's AC3 section is unchanged from what SPEC S2 already reviewed and flagged. Nothing new is broken.

Grepped wave1-lane02-final.md, docs/PROGRESS.md and every other wave1-lane02-*.md/.json report in the reports directory for a recorded owner ruling or a newly-run whole-suite triple: none found.
